title: Module laws for the transported scalar action on sections
statement: Let U,V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:U → V, and O a commutative-ring sheaf on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let L be the set inverse image, assumed to preserve finite limits, and La the fixed abelian inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-algebraic-structures]. Let Lr be left adjoint to the sectionwise ring direct image, with comparison er: Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L, and ea: La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L. Assume the ring and abelian adjunction hom equivalences commute with forgetting through er and ea. For any O-module sheaf G [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let A=La(FV(G)), OR be the ring sheaf underlying Lr(O), and let muV be the sectionwise scalar-action morphism. Define mu = prod.map(er.hom(O),ea.hom(FV(G))) followed by the inverse product comparison for L, L(muV), and ea.inv(FV(G)). Then there exist Module structures OR(W) acting on the existing abelian group A(W), for every W, such that mu(W) evaluated on each product section is the scalar multiplication of its two projections. This asserts sectionwise module axioms only; it asserts neither semilinear restrictions nor a sheaf of modules.

proof.text: Apply the distributivity theorem to the constructed scalar-action morphism etaleModuleScalarAction. Its sectionwise formula is definitional. This gives the two additive laws for the action precomposed with the inverse canonical categorical-product/sectionwise-product isomorphism.
Apply the scalar associativity theorem to the same morphism to obtain multiplication associativity and the unit law.

At each W define scalar multiplication to be this sectionwise action and use Mathlib Module.ofMinimalAxioms with the four laws. That constructor derives scalar-zero and module-zero from the two additive laws. This constructs Module structures on the existing abelian groups without choosing any arbitrary data from an existence theorem.

The canonical product isomorphism carries a section x to the pair of its projections, by its two projection equations. Its inverse followed by mu therefore evaluates at that pair to mu(x), by the inverse isomorphism identity. This proves the requested scalar-action formula for the constructed Module structures.

theorem etaleInverseImageModuleActionLaws (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V)
    (O : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f)] :
    let L := Scheme.etaleSetPullback f
    let La := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let a := Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let FaU := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FaV := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrU := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FrV := sheafForget (D := CommRingCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f
    let aS := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b
      (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    let Rr := b.sheafPushforwardContinuous CommRingCat.{u + 1}
      (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale) (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    ∀ (Lr : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1} ⥤
        Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
      (ar : Lr ⊣ Rr) (er : Lr ⋙ FrU ≅ FrV ⋙ L),
    let OR := (sheafCompose U.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj (Lr.obj O)
    let OV := (sheafCompose V.smallEtaleTopology
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj O
    let FV := SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u + 1} OV
    ∀ (ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L),
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (h : Lr.obj G ⟶ F),
        FrV.map (ar.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FrV.obj G) (FrU.obj F) (er.inv.app G ≫ FrU.map h)) ∧
      (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
          (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (h : La.obj G ⟶ F),
        FaV.map (a.homEquiv G F h) =
          aS.homEquiv (FaV.obj G) (FaU.obj F) (ea.inv.app G ≫ FaU.map h)) →
    ∀ G : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} OV,
    let A := La.obj (FV.obj G)
    let mu := prod.map (er.hom.app O) (ea.hom.app (FV.obj G)) ≫
      inv (prodComparison L (FrV.obj O) (FaV.obj (FV.obj G))) ≫
      L.map (etaleModuleScalarAction V O G) ≫ ea.inv.app (FV.obj G)
    ∃ m : ∀ W : U.Etaleᵒᵖ, Module (OR.obj.obj W) (A.obj.obj W),
      ∀ (W : U.Etaleᵒᵖ) (x : ((FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj A)).obj.obj W),
        @SMul.smul (OR.obj.obj W) (A.obj.obj W) (m W).toSMul
          ((prod.fst : (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj A) ⟶
            FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)).hom.app W x : OR.obj.obj W)
          ((prod.snd : (FrU.obj (Lr.obj O)) ⨯ (FaU.obj A) ⟶
            FaU.obj A).hom.app W x : A.obj.obj W) = mu.hom.app W x
